Subject Three book stores fined for selling indecent books.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Golder.

The case in which Ling Tsing Liang (林惠良),
Manager of the Sing Tze Book Store (新智書局), No. 164
Shantung Road, is charged with selling an indecent book
entitled "Goh Zau" (慾潮) (Wave of Adultery) was heard
at the Shanghai First Special District Court on the
morning of April 12 and the accused was fined $80.00.
The 100 copies of the book seized were ordered
to be confiscated.
The legal representative of the accused stated
that he would file an appeal.
The Judge then ordered that the accused be
released on security of $100.00.

On the morning of April 13 Woo Yien Loo (吳隱廬),
Manager of the Mei Li Book Store (曼麗書局), 221 Shantung
Road, was fined $300.00 by the Shanghai First Special
District Court for selling an indecent book entitled
"Sou S" (騷史) (Bewitching Stories). The 1730 copies
of the book seized were ordered to be confiscated.

On the same morning Tai Sz Ying (戴士英),
Manager of the Dah Sing Book Store (大新書局), No. D62,
Lane 140, Shantung Road, was fined $80.00 for selling
an indecent book entitled "Dzing Yoeh Sing Lung" (情慾新論)
(meaning New Ideas on Love and Passion).
The accused announced that he would file an
appeal.

Translation of extracts from a book entitled Secret
Stories of Dancing Halls (舞場秘密史).

Pages 57-60

Ha Ha Sien Sung (好先生 ) and Wei Eur
Sung (莞先生 ), two men, went together to a dance
hall. It was Ha Ha Sien Sung's first visit to such
a place.

Wei Eur Sung told him that dancing would
start immediately the music begins.

Ha Ha Sien Sung saw many couples of men
and women embrace, walk to the hall and move about.
These girls were so attractive that men were fascinated.

Upon returning home, Wei Eur Sung asked
Ha Ha Sien Sung why he had left in such a hurry.

Ha Ha Sien Sung replied that he thought
that all the men and women in the hall, who were
dancing and embracing each other, were doing "that
thing" (meaning sexual intercourse) while standing.

Later he asked other people whether the
men and women in the hall were engaged in acts of
lesbianism.

                                Yuen Li (慶云里 ), Shantung Rd.

题为《舞场秘密史》一书摘录的译文。

第57-60页

好先生（Ha Ha Sien Sung）和莞先生（Wei Eur Sung）两人一同去了一家舞厅。这是好先生第一次去这种地方。

莞先生告诉他，音乐一开始跳舞就会立即开始。

好先生看到许多男女相拥，走向舞池并移动。这些女孩如此迷人，让男人们着迷。

回家后，莞先生问好先生为什么走得这么匆忙。

好先生回答说，他认为舞厅里所有跳舞并互相拥抱的男女都在站着做“那件事”（意指性交）。

后来他问其他人，舞厅里的男女是否在从事女同性恋行为。

Pages 119-121.

Lawyer Sun (孫) who frequented brothels at nights
became acquainted with a sing song girl named Miao Vee
Lou Pah (妙味老八). He gave entertainments at the
girl's place every day. Nevertheless, he could not
attain his desire.

One day lawyer Sun reflected that although he
had wasted a large sum of money on the girl, yet he
had not succeeded. He then booked a room in the
Tung Fang Hotel (东方旅馆) and sent a chit to the
girl asking her to call at his room.

The sing song girl came. Lawyer Sun embraced
her and said, "You cannot go away to-day and must stay
here and sleep with me for the night. If you agree
to sleep with me for the night, this will be yours."
He showed the girl a diamond ring.
The girl examined the ring. It was worth
more than a thousand dollars.

She said, "Speaking frankly, you are the only
patron who has shown me so much affection and favour.
How can I reject any demand that you may put to me?"
The man then placed the diamond ring on one of
the girl's fingers.

"Don't be in such a hurry" said the girl.
"Are you trying to reject my request?" asked the
man.

The girl replied that she was under "special
martial law" and that "a red headed Ah San" was guarding
her "important pass". (This means that the girl was
having her menses.)

一日，孙律师心想，虽然自己在那女子身上挥霍了大笔金钱，却仍未得手。于是他在东方旅馆订了一个房间，并递送一张便条给该女子，请她到他的房间来。

该妓女前来。孙律师拥抱她并说道：“你今天不能离开，必须留在这里陪我过夜。如果你同意陪我过夜，这个就归你。”他向该女子展示了一枚钻戒。
该女子查看了戒指。其价值超过一千元。

她说：“坦白说，您是唯一一位对我如此厚爱眷顾的恩客。我又怎能拒绝您的任何要求呢？”
男子随即将钻戒戴在该女子的一根手指上。

“别这么着急，”女子说。
“你是想拒绝我的请求吗？”男子问道。

女子回答说，她正处于“特别戒严期”，且有一个“红头阿三”把守着她的“重要关口”。（意指该女子正值经期。）
